-118.23200,34.15170.name: CARE Fertility
-118.23200,34.15170.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Rodolfo Quintero, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.
